name: 23116 · Mechanicsvlle, VA
findings: ZIP 23116 (Mechanicsvlle) has 111 nonprofit organizations. 41 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 36 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 23116 (Mechanicsvlle) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 23116 (Mechanicsvlle) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 58% of the typical level).
